blocks.text: 为 7×24 小时运行而生的前沿网络防御

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 专为日常企业编码任务打造最佳价格性能比。在四项广泛使用的基准（DeepSWE 1.1、Terminal Bench 2.1、SWE-Atlas 和 FrontierCode v1.1）上取平均——这些基准针对我们在 GitHub Copilot 中看到的日常企业编码任务——MAI Code 2 以 40% 的价格提供 GPT-6.1 Sol 98% 的性能，以仅 5% 的价格提供 Claude Opus 5.5 96% 的性能。

blocks.text: Seven new world-class models at scalable price-performance

inlines.text: Seven new world-class models at scalable price-performance

blocks.text: Nov 17, 2026 ·Announcements ·Ignite

inlines.text: Nov 17, 2026 ·Announcements ·Ignite

blocks.text: At MAI, our mission is to build you the very best models in the world and keep every developer and every enterprise at the frontier of capability.

inlines.text: At MAI, our mission is to build you the very best models in the world and keep every developer and every enterprise at the frontier of capability.

blocks.text: But as token spend skyrockets, we know that you also want models at a price point that lets you run agents 24/7 doing real engineering work.

inlines.text: But as token spend skyrockets, we know that you also want models at a price point that lets you run agents 24/7 doing real engineering work.

blocks.text: That’s why today we’re releasing a family of seven new world class models at a truly exceptional price-performance.

inlines.text: That’s why today we’re releasing a family of seven new world class models at a truly exceptional price-performance.

blocks.text: Here’s the lineup:

inlines.text: Here’s the lineup:
MAI Cyber 2 Flash
beats GPT-6 Astra’s quality at less than 2% of the cost per task on the CyberGym-E2E benchmark.
MAI Code 2
reaches 98% of the coding quality of GPT-6.1 Sol at about 40% of the price. And against Opus 5.5, it reaches 96% performance for just 5% of the price.
MAI Code 2 Flash
shows comparable performance GPT-6 Luna at 65% of the price, and Haiku 5.5 at 20% of the price.
MAI Image 2.7
is #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing, outperforming GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (max) at just one-fifth of the price.
MAI Realtime 1
outperforms GPT-Realtime 2.1 and starts at just $0.01 per audio minute.
Dragon Copilot Transcribe
is built on MAI Transcribe 2, the world’s fastest and most accurate multilingual transcription model, and already powers 10 million patient encounters a month with multilingual error rates halved.
Decision 1.1
is the latest decision model from Microsoft, 50x faster and 79x cheaper than GPT-6.1 Sol.
Maia 200
, Microsoft’s second-generation AI accelerator, is now in production running our largest models, achieving 1.7x more tokens per watt.

blocks.text: Frontier cyber defense built to run 24/7

inlines.text: Frontier cyber defense built to run 24/7

blocks.text: Security, alignment and containment are the most important priorities for agent development in 2027 and beyond. That’s our top priority. We need to run monitoring and control agents defending and patching live production systems 24/7. That’s why MAI Cyber 2 Flash was designed to deliver frontier intelligence at a fraction of the cost.

blocks.text: Incredible coding performance at a fraction of the cost

inlines.text: Incredible coding performance at a fraction of the cost

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 is built for the best price-performance for everyday enterprise coding tasks. Averaged over four widely used benchmarks that target the everyday enterprise coding tasks we see in GitHub Copilot (DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal Bench 2.1, SWE-Atlas and FrontierCode v1.1), MAI Code 2 gives you 98% of the performance of GPT-6.1 Sol at 40% of the price, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5’s performance at just 5% of the price.

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 Flash is designed for high-volume, everyday tasks like code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes, and rapid iterations, while bringing quality at a much lower cost. It performs comparably to GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 65% and 20% of the price, respectively, across three coding benchmarks measuring day-to-day, high-volume routine coding tasks (DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal Bench 2.1 and SWE-Atlas). It’s available in GitHub Copilot and in a limited-access preview in Microsoft Foundry.
